headline: Customer Success & AI Operations · 12 years in email | 8 years in CS
executiveSummary: Customer Success and AI Operations operator with 12 years in email and 8 years in Customer Success. Employee #13 at Resend through hypergrowth (5k → 130k+ paying customers, ARR up 15x, and tickets 200 → 1,500+/week); previously led a 17-person global CS team at Customer.io covering $40M+ ARR. Builds the foundations customer teams run on: AI support agents with custom evals, product code, integrations, and a tight feedback loop between customers and engineering.

roles.title: Customer Success Engineer
description: Employee #13. Owned the customer experience through hypergrowth: 5k → 130k+ paying customers, ARR up 15x, and tickets 200 → 1,500+/week
Built an AI support agent from scratch (intent, classification, tool use, and replies) with custom evals and benchmarks; resolves ~25% of conversations
Cut resolution time by 70% and held first-response SLAs while ticket volume grew 7x, consistently at 2–4x the throughput of peer CSEs
Closed the loop with Engineering through recurring deep dives, demos, and Feedback Friday, a weekly customer-feedback newsletter
Shipped product code directly (rate-limit automation and support tooling) and helped hire and onboard the support team

roles.title: Success Team Manager, Mid-Market & Scale
description: Led a global CS team of up to 17 direct and indirect reports across 4 continents: 100% retention and 7 promotions in 12 months
Owned ~80% of CS-covered accounts ($40M+ ARR) at 115% team NRR, 130% on my own book
Doubled Scale segment coverage with no added headcount through webinar programs and automation
Built Next.js automations and Gong, Planhat, Slack, and Zendesk integrations saving 2,000+ team hours a year
Automated account assignment with suggestions by region and book load, replacing a manual, Director-gated process

roles.title: Customer Success Team Lead
description: Led the Vitally → Planhat migration; coached CSMs to 120% team NRR while carrying the largest book among leads at 140% NRR

roles.title: Customer Success Manager
description: Managed 50+ strategic accounts at 145% NRR (vs. 110% target)

roles.title: Manager, Growth Operations
description: Built the Customer and Growth functions supporting an $8M Series A
Implemented a GTM stack cutting costs 60%, doubling activation rate, and halving time to activate through automated user journeys

roles.title: Growth Architect
description: Technical lead for Customer Experience and Monetization; ran messaging operations delivering 10M+ emails and 12M+ in-app messages a year

roles.title: CS Specialist → Manager
description: Migrated customer messaging from Intercom and Appcues to Customer.io; cut campaign deployment time by 85%
Implemented ML-driven churn prediction, reducing churn by 15%

earlier.description: Built the email program from scratch to 500k+ subscribers, then led global product marketing for mobile launches (40M+ downloads)
